_meta.name: Enterprise Inbox Triage & Autonomous SLA Sentinel
_meta.description: Continuously batches business emails, analyzes priority and sentiment, humanizes proposed responses, exposes explainable approval actions, and persists operational intelligence.

nodes.name: Fetch Email Dataset
nodes.description: Retrieve synthetic email messages from local development fixture or event batch

nodes.name: Summarize & Categorize Emails

nodes.name: Humanize Drafts & Attach XAI

nodes.name: Persist Summary Outcome
nodes.description: Save summary metrics and outcome to pattern memory
